business_problem: Enztec researchers spent nearly 90% of their work week gathering, filtering and reviewing medical publications, slowing the discovery phase of new orthopedic device projects.
solution_summary: Enztec partnered with IBM to build an AI-assisted publication-review workflow on IBM watsonx.ai and IBM Watson Discovery. The solution targets the earliest stage of orthopedic product research, where teams must collect, summarize and evaluate large volumes of literature before new projects advance. Watson Discovery provides intelligent document understanding across medical articles and related content, while watsonx.ai generates executive summaries and helps automate filtering so researchers can focus on the most relevant evidence. In the resulting process, selected publications are processed, logged and summarized, and researchers can search more source material without doing every step manually. That architecture converts publication review from a labor-intensive reading exercise into a searchable, summarized research pipeline that expands coverage, accelerates insight generation and helps Enztec identify potential device risks earlier in the design cycle.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Automates filtering and summary generation across medical publications so researchers can focus on the most important findings.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Processes, logs and helps search the medical literature underlying Enztec's device research work.

data_flow: Medical publications are ingested and analyzed through Watson Discovery, watsonx.ai filters and summarizes the most relevant documents, and Enztec researchers search the resulting knowledge base to guide new product research and early risk identification.
business_outcome: Enztec accelerated literature review, widened research coverage and improved its ability to spot device risks and failure indicators earlier, turning publication review into a more scalable and decision-useful research process.
architecture_clues: The system combines document understanding and generative summarization rather than using a single black-box model.
